extraction.document_summary: AIA Pro Lifetime Protector (II) is an AIA Investment-linked Plan (ILP) that combines protection with wealth accumulation. It provides death coverage and protection against disability plus “150 multi-stage critical illnesses”. The brochure also highlights that “Guaranteed protection for the first 10 years” means the policy and any unit-deducting riders “will not lapse for the first 10 years… regardless of investment performance” (if regular premiums are fully paid and no withdrawals are made). Critical illness and disability protection is enhanced via optional riders, including Total Disability Accelerator (II) (paying up to “100% of basic coverage amount” for total and permanent disability, ending at age 70) and Lifetime Critical Cover rider with a Power Reset feature. Power Reset can restore coverage to “100%… if this rider is still in force for 12 months” after the latest diagnosed (or relapsed) critical illness and can support multiple claims “up to 300% of your coverage amount”. Investment guidance is provided via Mercer Guided Portfolios (Pro Adventurous, Pro Balanced, Pro Cautious).
quality_notes: Brochure provides clear high-level mechanics (10-year guaranteed protection, Power Reset, PowerUp Dollar, and portfolio names) and several rider-specific rules.
No explicit entry age, maximum coverage age for the base policy, free-look, grace period, premium guarantees (beyond 10-year non-lapse condition), or underwriting method are stated.

The brochure does not list full critical illness definitions, benefit amounts for the base death/critical illness coverage, or detailed exclusion wording—only a generic statement that some conditions result in no benefits payable.

policies.quick_summary: ILP combining death protection with disability and 150 multi-stage critical illness coverage, with optional riders (e.g., Total Disability Accelerator (II), Lifetime Critical Cover with Power Reset, Relapse Benefit). Includes 10-year guaranteed non-lapse protection (subject to premiums paid and no withdrawals) and Mercer Guided Portfolios for wealth accumulation; PowerUp Dollar may increase coverage depending on AIA Vitality status (paid at death or age 100 if still an active member). Coverage can be increased at milestones (up to S$200,000) without medical underwriting, and insured can reduce protection in later years.
policies.coverage_term_description: Guaranteed protection for the first 10 years (policy and any unit-deducting riders do not lapse for the first 10 years, subject to regular premiums fully paid and no withdrawals).
policy_termination_events: Not stated in a specific list; brochure includes a generic note that there are conditions where no benefits will be payable and that early termination may involve costs and surrender value may be zero or less than total premiums paid.
important_caveats: Brochure states this plan is an ILP with investment risks: performance of ILP sub-funds is not guaranteed and unit value may fall or rise.
Guaranteed protection for the first 10 years depends on regular premiums fully paid and no withdrawals made.
A generic note states there are certain conditions where no benefits will be payable, and terms/exclusions are specified in the policy contract.
